name: currency-convert
description: Currency conversion and European Central Bank (ECB) reference exchange rates via the keyless Frankfurter API. Convert amounts between currencies, fetch latest rates for a base currency, look up historical rates for a past date, and list supported currency codes. Keyless — no credentials required.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: currency.convert
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using the latest ECB reference rate. Returns the amount, source/target currency, the rate, the converted result, and the rate date.

amount.description: Amount of the source currency to convert.

from.description: Source currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP (case-insensitive).

to.description: Target currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP (case-insensitive).

tools.name: currency.rates
tools.description: Get the latest ECB reference exchange rates for a base currency. Optionally restrict the response to specific target currencies.

symbols.description: Optional target currencies to include: a comma-separated string (e.g. "USD,GBP,JPY") or an array of codes. If omitted, all available rates are returned.

tools.name: currency.historical
tools.description: Get the ECB reference rate for a specific past date (YYYY-MM-DD) and convert an amount between two currencies on that date.

amount.description: Amount of the source currency to convert (default 1).

tools.name: currency.list_currencies
tools.description: List all currency codes supported by the Frankfurter/ECB dataset, mapped to their full names.
